name: Speakup BV
notes:
Speakup (AS49627) has a selective peering policy. That means we evaluate every peering request and only peer with networks if there is a mutual benefit.

Please note that we are connected to routeservers on most IXPs we are connected to

Please do submit a request for bilateral peering if:

 - You are a customer
 - You are an ISP that provides access to consumers / businesses
 - You otherwise feel it is mutually beneficial to set up bilateral peering.

PNI is also possible in some circumstances. Evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Peering Requests will only be considered when they are submitted to the correct address. Please see our contact information below.
